name: build-bell
description: A counter-bell strike and a toast when a long command or a long turn finishes, so you can look away while a build, an install, a test run or Claude goes. It says how long it took and whether it failed. Quiet for anything short.

minSeconds.title: Ring after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: A Bash command or a turn that runs this long rings the bell and shows a toast.

sound.title: Bell sound
sound.description: Play the bell. Off keeps the toast and the silence.

shortTurns.title: Tick after a short turn
shortTurns.description: A soft tick when a turn ran a few seconds and no toast is due.
